methodology.agent_model: Deterministic scripted agent (no LLM). It fixes the root-cause step once any feedback in its context names the offending field, and follows the step the runner asks for next.
methodology.baseline_policy: Common ReAct-style loop without a transaction layer: append the raw error to the context, retry the failing step up to 3 times, then restart from step 1 (up to 3 restarts). Each tool call auto-commits and side effects fire immediately. Duplicate-key errors on replay are treated as already done.
methodology.agenttx_policy: Same agent and tools through the AgentTx engine with the default rollback policy (local depth 2, 1 global reset, replay budget factor 2.0). The agent receives only the Clean Hint.
methodology.modeled_latency: Modeled end-to-end latency = tool calls × assumed LLM latency per call + measured harness wall time.

step_latency.label: Direct write (no protocol)
step_latency.description: Before: the tool's effect as one auto-committed RocksDB put. No transaction, snapshot, journal or rollback.

step_latency.label: AgentTx engine (in-process)
step_latency.description: After: snapshot pointer, journaled overlay write, dependency-graph update and output record, embedded as a library.

step_latency.label: AgentTx over gRPC (loopback)
step_latency.description: After, as a proxy: full ExecuteStep round-trip over HTTP/2 on localhost, including protobuf encoding and the engine.
